description: Generate a JSON Schema from one or more sample JSON values. Infers types, required fields, formats (email, date, URI, UUID), and detects enum patterns from multiple examples.

detect_enums.description: Whether to detect enum values from string fields across samples (default: true, requires >= 3 samples)

samples.description: Array of sample JSON values to infer the schema from. More samples produce a more accurate schema.

title.description: Optional title for the generated schema

name: generate_json_schema
